label: MICRA limit on noneconomic damages, injury - starting amount
applies: Noneconomic losses in an action against a health care provider based on professional negligence, other than wrongful death
movesWhen: Increases by $40,000 each 1 January for 10 years, to a ceiling of $750,000
note: This is the figure the section prints as the starting amount from 1 January 2023, not the amount operative today. Counting the stated increases from that date gives $470,000 for 2026, which is arithmetic from the schedule rather than a figure the section states, and should be confirmed against the section before it is relied on. The flat $250,000 still widely quoted is the pre-2023 section.
author: Aaron Bollinger
